__comment: Example storage server config (M7). Copy, edit, and pass with -config. ALL capability switches are OFF by default; this example shows the DB-enabled shape. Connection settings are required only for an enabled backend and must point at YOUR backends - the examples below are synthetic placeholders, never live endpoints. Capacity keys left unset fall back to the owner-approved D4 defaults. Env overrides (STORAGE_MONGO_ENABLED, STORAGE_MONGO_URI, STORAGE_POSTGRES_DSN, ...) take precedence over the file.
